Spell Effect: Bizarre Surge.name: Spell Effect: Bizarre Surge
Spell Effect: Bizarre Surge.description:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lV8FkHZtzZu7Cy6j]{Evolution Surge} with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.items.vByKHEVb5SQj4nm9]{Bizarre Surge}.

You pull forth secrets of the future to reshape the form of your eidolon, evolving features and structure perfect for the exact issue facing you. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lV8FkHZtzZu7Cy6j]{evolution surge} you can choose from the following effects in addition to the normal effects:

  • Your eidolon gains echolocation, granting it hearing as a precise sense up to 20 feet.
  • Your eidolon gains a resistance to mental damage equal to half your level.

Heightened (3rd) Your eidolon gains a +1 status bonus to Will saves.

Heightened (5th) Your eidolon gains lifesense as an imprecise sense up to 30 feet.

Victory's Companion.name: Victory's Companion
Victory's Companion.description: Your eidolon knows victory as an old friend, sharing its path in each step. Your eidolon increases the die size of its unarmed attacks by 1 step. Your eidolon can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.BPn644yIO8XN3MGs]{Heart of a Warrior} action as a free action when you roll for initiative, so long as it is aware of at least one enemy. When your eidolon reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points while under the effects of Heart of a Warrior it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round and it can use this additional action to Stride or Strike.

Tandem Boost.name: Tandem Boost
Tandem Boost.description:
You and your eidolon join powers to boost each other. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HStu2Yhw3iQER9tY]{Boost Eidolon} and both you and your eidolon gain the effects of boost eidolon. Any damage bonus you gain from boost eidolon applies to your unarmed and weapon attacks as well and use your weapon damage dice for determining your status bonus to damage.

Special If you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TYbCj4dgXDOZou9k]{Reinforce Eidolon} cantrip, you can choose to cast it instead of boost eidolon

Incarnate Arrival.name: Incarnate Arrival
Incarnate Arrival.description:
Requirements Your eidolon was manifested this turn.

Your eidolon bursts with almighty power once released from your sigil. All creatures in a @Template[distance:10|type:emanation] around your eidolon take @Damage[(2+(floor(@actor.level/2)))d4[@actor.flags.pf2e.incarnate-type]]{2d4 plus an additional 1d4 damage} per 2 levels you possess with a @Check[type:reflex|basic:true|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.spellDC.value)] save against your spell DC.

The type of damage must be from the following list and if your eidolon has one of the traits listed, it must select that trait: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, poison, slashing, sonic, vitality, void, water (cold or bludgeoning), or wood (piercing or bludgeoning). If the creature has more than one of these traits, you choose which damage type to deal.

If you use Manifest Incarnate Eidolon to unmanifest your eidolon, it can use this activity before it unmanifests.

Special This activity has the trait matching your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Manifest Incarnate Eidolon.name: Manifest Incarnate Eidolon
Manifest Incarnate Eidolon.description:
Your incarnate eidolon appears with triumphant force. When you use this action, you choose a square within 30 feet to manifest your eidolon. If your eidolon was already manifested, you unmanifest it instead. When you use Manifest Incarnate Eidolon, your eidolon can use an action or activity that takes 2-actions or less to perform as part of its arrival or departure but Manifest Incarnate Eidolon gains the tandem trait if you do.

Your eidolon remains manifested until the end of your next turn, but you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3f5DMFu8fPiqHpRg]{Sustain} its presence for up to 1 minute. For every round the eidolon remains manifested the emanation of its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.0fvd9aASh27TJYOj]{Incarnate Arrival} departure increases by 5 feet up to a maximum of 50 feet. You can choose to suppress this effect when it unmanifests or reduce the emanation to a minimum of a 5-foot emanation.

The conduit that allows your eidolon to manifest is also a tether between you. Your eidolon must remain within 100 feet of you at all times and can't willingly go beyond that limit. If forced beyond this distance, or if you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, your eidolon's physical form dissolves: your eidolon unmanifests, and you need to use Manifest Incarnate Eidolon to manifest it again.

Special This activity has the trait matching your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Rampaging Oni.name: Rampaging Oni
Rampaging Oni.description: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3, Int –1, Wis +0, Cha +2; +3 AC (+2 Dex cap)

Effect: Fabricate Tool.name: Effect: Fabricate Tool
Effect: Fabricate Tool.description: If you are 7th level or higher, you gain a +1 item bonus to checks with the item you summoned.

Be Not Afraid!.name: Be Not Afraid!
Be Not Afraid!.description: Your eidolon reveals a glimpse of its true form to onlookers, frightening foes and encouraging allies. Your eidolon attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} one enemy within range and then calms allies within 30 feet, reducing their frightened condition by 1. If the enemy it chose to Demoralize has the unholy trait, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its check.

Eyes.name: Eyes
Eyes.description: Your eidolon has additional eyes, either compound or simply arranged irregularly on its body, enhancing its detections. Your eidolon gains a +1 circumstance bonus to vision-based @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} checks. At the beginning of each turn, your eidolon can choose one enemy to fix its gaze upon and that creature cannot flank your eidolon, though it can still provide flanking to its allies. Your eidolon’s second skill must be a skill that uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} activity. If you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.a6xUSibsRaclbSz3]{Ever-Vigilant Senses} class feat, it treats its level as 2 higher when determining which foes can flank it.

Arcane Etudiant.name: Arcane Etudiant
Arcane Etudiant.description: Str +0, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +4, Wis +1, Cha +0; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Suppress Eidolon.name: Suppress Eidolon
Suppress Eidolon.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You suppress your eidolon and present your face within your eidolon. Your eidolon cannot act until the beginning of your next turn, and you become your summoner again until the beginning of your next turn. You can use your abilities instead of your eidolons and suppress all of your eidolon abilities while your eidolon is suppressed in this way. You and your eidolon are targeted by effects and subject to area of effect while your eidolon is suppressed and you are considered to be occupying your eidolon’s space for the purposes of being targeted by effects.

Aberrative Devourer.name: Aberrative Devourer
Aberrative Devourer.description: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +0; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Mouth.name: Mouth
Mouth.description: Your eidolon possesses one or more strange maws which gibber and cause distress when in close proximity. Your eidolon gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} and it does not take a penalty to its Demoralize if it doesn’t share a language with the target. Your eidolon’s secondary skill is Intimidation.

Spell Effect: Ancient Surge.name: Spell Effect: Ancient Surge
Spell Effect: Ancient Surge.description:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lV8FkHZtzZu7Cy6j]{Evolution Surge} with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.items.lsB3RzmVmK27iWv3]{Ancient Surge}.

You unlock the power of the past, returning your eidolon to a mighty state from the beginning of time. Choose one of the following effects:

  • Your eidolon gains tremorsense as an imprecise sense up to 20 feet.
  • Your eidolon gains a resistance to acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage equal to half your level. If your eidolon has a weakness to the selected damage type, you instead reduce the weakness by an equal amount.

Heightened (3rd) Your eidolon gains a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves.

Heightened (5th) Your eidolon treats its degree of success on saves against effects that would give it the grabbed, prone, or restrained conditions as one step better.

Churning Ooze.name: Churning Ooze
Churning Ooze.description: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +0; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Effect: Aura of Knowledge.name: Effect: Aura of Knowledge
Effect: Aura of Knowledge.description: All creatures within the area gain a +1 status bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. When a creature in the aura fails (but doesn't critically fail) a Recall Knowledge check using any skill, the creature learns the correct answer and an erroneous answer.

Effect: Heart of a Warrior Temp Hp.name: Effect: Heart of a Warrior Temp Hp

Effect: Aura of Time.name: Effect: Aura of Time
Effect: Aura of Time.description: All creatures within the aura are not affected by either fortune or misfortune effects.

Aura of Knowledge.name: Aura of Knowledge
Aura of Knowledge.description: Your eidolon radiates an aura of knowledge and understanding. Your eidolon gains an aura of knowledge in a 10-foot emanation, granting all within the area a +1 status bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. When a creature in the aura fails (but doesn't critically fail) a Recall Knowledge check using any skill, the creature learns the correct answer and an erroneous answer. Your eidolon becomes a master in Academia Lore.

Extinguish.name: Extinguish
Extinguish.description: Your eidolon can target a @Template[distance:5|type:burst] within 30 feet as a single action with the concentrate trait to automatically extinguish non-magical fires in the area.

Pure Life Force.name: Pure Life Force
Pure Life Force.description: Your eidolon is fused with vitality. Your eidolon’s Strikes deal an extra 1 vitality damage. Your eidolon gains a life force of its choice between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Q6f0Rzb4vwJenVXo]{elemental}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.NqCwEgFAAt4kLr23]{light}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.kFoaEGrS62JC95Pq]{plant}.

Gelatinous Expansion.name: Gelatinous Expansion
Gelatinous Expansion.description:
Your ooze adjusts its shape to adapt to its needs. Your eidolon gains its choice of one of the listed effects until the end of your next turn. It can only have one effect active at a time.

Acidic Viscosity: Your eidolon’s touch is acidic. Creatures that successfully make melee attack rolls against your eidolon take @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[persistent,acid]]{persistent acid} damage equal to half your level.

Elastic Blows: Your eidolon can stretch its pseudo-limbs and body. Your eidolon’s unarmed attacks increase their reach by 5 feet.

Grasping Goo: Your eidolon’s goo sticks to those it touches, eating away at them. When your eidolon successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapples} an enemy, they take @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[persistent,acid]]{persistent acid} damage equal to half your level.

Weapon Shape: Your eidolon shapes its unarmed attack, altering its attributes. Your eidolon changes its primary melee unarmed attack to another primary unarmed attack it could have selected at 1st level, gaining the appropriate traits and damage die for its new selection.

Unspeakable Demonstration.name: Unspeakable Demonstration
Unspeakable Demonstration.description:
Your eidolon performs an unspeakable demonstration using its unnatural physiology. For 1 minute, your eidolon performs the unspeakable in a @Template[distance:15|type:emanation]. Enemies that start their turn within the emanation must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classDC.value)] save against your spell DC. Creatures that fail their save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{fascinated} by your eidolon for 1 minute and it gains effects corresponding to its choice from Unnatural Physiology. Hostile actions from you or your eidolon do not break the target’s fascination, nor do hostile actions from your allies against the creature’s allies break the fascination. A creature that ends its fascinated condition from this effect cannot be affected again for 1 minute.

Eyes Your eidolon’s eyes project infinite confounding patterns. When your eidolon uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} on an area with creatures fascinated by its Unspeakable Demonstration, it can compare the result of its Perception to the Will DC of the fascinated creatures. On a success, the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{dazzled} for 1 round, or 1 minute on a critical success. This activity gains the visual trait.

Mind Your eidolon’s mind penetrates into the minds of others via discontent. When your eidolon deals damage with one of its unarmed attacks to a creature fascinated by its Unspeakable Demonstration, the creature cannot take reactions until the beginning of its next turn. This activity gains the mental trait.

Mouth Your eidolon’s mouth spews vitriol and discord. When your eidolon successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralizes} a creature fascinated by its Unspeakable Demonstration, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{deafened} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 1} for as long as it is fascinated. These conditions apply even if the target of your Demoralize is immune to fear or would not gain the frightened condition from a successful Demoralize. This activity gains the auditory trait.

Skin Your eidolon’s skin vibrates, shudders, or some other unusual contortion. When your eidolon successfully makes a melee Strike or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} against a creature fascinated by its Unspeakable Demonstration, the target takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[persistent,acid]]{persistent acid damage equal to half your level}.

Flying Beast.name: Flying Beast
Flying Beast.description:
Your eidolon has great wings which it uses to propel itself. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Bj0GvPgyPiC2kDH1]{Glider Form} feat. As a single action with the move trait, your eidolon can launch itself up to its Speed in the air if it is on the ground.

At 12th level, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.h8OB6zcdIqUPS6PC]{Airborne Form} feat, even though you don't meet the level prerequisites.

Vital Juggernaut.name: Vital Juggernaut
Vital Juggernaut.description: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int –1, Wis +1, Cha +0, +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Disrupt Reality.name: Disrupt Reality
Disrupt Reality.description: Your eidolon’s presence is so disruptive to the planes that magic becomes unstable and difficult to use. Your eidolon gains an aura of disrupting reality in a @Template[distance:20|type:emanation]. Creatures that use the Cast a Spell activity within the aura must make a @Check[dc:7|type:flat] check. If they fail, instead of the normal effects of the spell they produce the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.rollable-tables.N0pDFNCffTe2Du39]{Wellspring Surge}. Your eidolon may choose to activate or deactivate this aura as a single action that has the concentrate trait.

Effect: Gelatinous Expansion.name: Effect: Gelatinous Expansion
Effect: Gelatinous Expansion.description:
Your ooze adjusts its shape to adapt to its needs. Your eidolon gains its choice of one of the listed effects until the end of your next turn. It can only have one effect active at a time.

Acidic Viscosity: Your eidolon’s touch is acidic. Creatures that successfully make melee attack rolls against your eidolon take @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[persistent,acid]]{persistent acid} damage equal to half your level.

Elastic Blows: Your eidolon can stretch its pseudo-limbs and body. Your eidolon’s unarmed attacks increase their reach by 5 feet.

Grasping Goo: Your eidolon’s goo sticks to those it touches, eating away at them. When your eidolon successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapples} an enemy, they take @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[persistent,acid]]{persistent acid} damage equal to half your level.

Weapon Shape: Your eidolon shapes its unarmed attack, altering its attributes. Your eidolon changes its primary melee unarmed attack to another primary unarmed attack it could have selected at 1st level, gaining the appropriate traits and damage die for its new selection.

Add your chosen attack from the list below. I recommend storing your alternative attack for later so you don't have to re-add runes or other effects your Eidolon's strikes might have every time you choose this effect.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.8dyatrsCMoIPuOlE]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.8IodRUpyU4nXGyAv]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.cIAB28BfwNA2uTQv]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.GEVoWzCBjidkO6DG]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.8EJNylotPDelRtZK]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.XNgPUKsnRQO2OS2O]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.ZXrAWVLwKxz5kovL]

Protean Riddler.name: Protean Riddler
Protean Riddler.description: Str +1, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +3; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Ephemeral Existence.name: Ephemeral Existence
Ephemeral Existence.description: Your eidolon is a creature made of dreamstuff, and your dreams change its very makeup. Your eidolon can alter one of its evolution feats to another 1st-level evolution feat to which it has access each day during your daily preparations, as its form encapsulates an ever-shifting identity. This change lasts for 1 day, but the eidolon can choose to prolong the change durings its daily preparations the next day or alter it to another appropriate evolution feat. Your eidolon must still meet any prerequisites for the new evolution feat and if the evolution feat is a prerequisite for another evolution feat it has, it cannot be changed. It gains the Cast a Spell activity and learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment}, which it can cast as an innate occult cantrip.

Village.name: Village
Village.description: Your gold-masked eidolon lurks in urban places, dealing in coins or the artifice of man. It gains the metal trait. Your eidolon ignores difficult terrain caused by man made obstructions and crowds.

Jaathoom.name: Jaathoom
Jaathoom.description:
Your genie eidolon has the air trait. Your eidolon can float but is still tethered to you. Your eidolon has a fly Speed equal to its land Speed, but with limited mobility. Your eidolon can't rise more than a few inches above the ground when it uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly}. This means your eidolon can move above many types of difficult or hazardous terrain without moving slowly or being damaged, even though it can't fly without limit. Your eidolon can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, and take similar actions, using its fly Speed for any calculations that would use its land Speed, and your eidolon can use Acrobatics for these checks instead of Athletics. If you select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.xXHoyccK5ZG2AJKg]{Skilled Partner} class feat, your eidolon can use its proficiency in Acrobatics instead of Athletics for prerequisites for skill feats if they would apply to these actions. Your eidolon’s second skill is Acrobatics.

[[/act leap skill=acrobatics]]

[[/act high-jump skill=acrobatics]]

[[/act long-jump skill=acrobatics]]

Arbiter of the Path.name: Arbiter of the Path
Arbiter of the Path.description:
Your eidolon has come to know its path so well that its steps now forge the path, rather than following it. Your eidolon gains the listed effect for its bounded domain.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.SY84YXTJ7YI1XdiS]{Duty}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.ipfhdIacg4dFSJLE]{Fate}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.X1SqLaqsQgOM3vLg]{Knowledge}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.qOcbAADPmp9bMQnC]{Time}

Heart of a Warrior.name: Heart of a Warrior
Heart of a Warrior.description:
Requirements Your eidolon is in an encounter with at least one enemy creature.

Your eidolon thrives in battle. For 1 minute, when your eidolon succeeds at a Strike or Athletics maneuver against a creature of no more than 4 levels below your level it gains temporary Hit Points equal to 2 plus half your level that last until the end of your next turn.

Terrifying Smite.name: Terrifying Smite
Terrifying Smite.description: Your eidolon makes a Strike against an enemy that has you or one of your allies within its reach. On a hit, the target takes an additional @Damage[3d8[spirit]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. Creatures that are unholy cannot reduce their frightened condition below 1 unless they spend a single action that has the concentrate trait to thwart your eidolon’s holy power.

Vitality Springs Forth.name: Vitality Springs Forth
Vitality Springs Forth.description:
Your eidolon’s touch on life is so great, that even after it has touched you, it persists. When your eidolon restores Hit Points to a creature, it grants that creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.fJSNOw4zHGbIm4bZ]{fast healing} equal to half your level for 4 rounds. When your eidolon deals vitality damage to a creature, that creature takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[persistent,vitality]|traits:item:slug:vitality-springs-forth] damage equal to half your level. Your eidolon gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.W5llrHBDsYYG68ep]{Bursting Life Spring} free action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.DC10UMpCz4sJmwcU]{Effect: Vitality Springs Forth}

Project Senses.name: Project Senses
Project Senses.description:
Requirements Your eidolon is unmanifested.

Your eidolon projects its senses into you, allowing you to perceive using its senses. When you do, you can sense and use skills using any of your eidolon’s senses or abilities, through your eidolon's body for up to 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this effect.

Special This action has the trait matching your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal). Your eidolon can also use this ability. When it does, it projects its senses into your body.

Jabali Shuyookh.name: Jabali Shuyookh
Jabali Shuyookh.description: Your eidolon crushes creatures grabbed by it, dealing @Damage[(@actor.level)[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning damage equal to its level} to creatures that it successfully grabbed, either with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} or one of its abilities. When your eidolon grants a wish, it grants the simplest fulfillment of the wish possible that would meet the request. If the wish when spoken has more than 5 words, it has a @Check[dc:10|type:flat].

Glory Seeker.name: Glory Seeker
Glory Seeker.description:
Requirements Your eidolon is under the effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.BPn644yIO8XN3MGs]{Heart of a Warrior}.

 Your eidolon unleashes a ferocious challenge. Your eidolon attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a creature it can see ignoring the penalty for not sharing a language with that creature. If your eidolon succeeds at its Demoralize against the creature, its frightened condition can't decrease to less than 1 at the end of its turn if your eidolon has made a successful Strike or Athletics maneuver against it since its last turn.

Effect: Not Against Me.name: Effect: Not Against Me
Effect: Not Against Me.description: Your eidolon hardens itself against attempts to harm it. Your eidolon gains a +1 status bonus to its AC and one save of its choice for 1 round.

Kizidhar.name: Kizidhar
Kizidhar.description:
Your genie eidolon has the plant and wood traits. Your eidolon ignores difficult terrain caused by plants and can pass through barriers made of plant material by Squeezing and it can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} 5 feet in 1 round, or 10 feet on a critical success. Your eidolon uses Nature to Squeeze in this way instead of Acrobatics. Your eidolon’s second skill is Nature.

[[/act squeeze skill=nature]]

Effect: Vitality Springs Forth.name: Effect: Vitality Springs Forth
Effect: Vitality Springs Forth.description:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.BwfIMZ7fGH3d9VFt]{Vitality Springs Forth}

When your eidolon restores Hit Points to a creature, it grants that creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.fJSNOw4zHGbIm4bZ]{fast healing} equal to half your level for 4 rounds.

Aura of Time.name: Aura of Time
Aura of Time.description: Your eidolon radiates an aura that hardens the rhythms of time. Your eidolon gains an aura of time in a 10-foot emanation, granting creatures within the aura a +2 status bonus to saves against effects that would give them the slowed condition. Creatures that begin their turn in the aura reduce the duration of the quickened or slowed conditions by 1 round.

Coordinated Stride.name: Coordinated Stride
Coordinated Stride.description:
Requirement You have at least 2 eidolons manifested.

Your eidolons move into position. Each of your eidolons uses a single action to Stride. If either of them has the corresponding movement type they can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead.

Warpwave Strike.name: Warpwave Strike
Warpwave Strike.description:
Your eidolon attacks with a disrupting effect. Your eidolon Strikes a creature with one of its unarmed attacks. If your eidolon’s Strike is successful, the target of the eidolon’s Strike must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)]. Creatures that fail their save roll [[/r 1d8]] to determine the effect. This effect lasts for [[/r 1d4]] rounds.

Result Effect
1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 3} on critical failure)
2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} and gains @Damage[4d6[temp-hp]]
3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{blinded}on a critical failure)
4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{3} on critical failure)
5 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} by filaments of energy
